sources.summary: The wildcard user-agent group has an empty Disallow value and advertises a BFE sitemap. This does not grant content-reuse rights.
The applicable federal legal notice reserves content rights and says prior written permission is required to reproduce site elements. Downloading or copying transfers no rights.

decision: Live BFE content collection and reproduction stopped: prior written permission for reproduction is not documented. Only robots and the applicable official legal notice were requested; neither content seed was fetched.
